headline: FIFA World Cup 2026 — Round of 16
items: LIVE: Round of 16 underway — Canada 0-0 Morocco at halftime (Houston); Paraguay vs France to follow (5:00 PM ET, Philadelphia)
RESULT: Argentina 3-2 Cape Verde (AET) — Messi opens scoring, Romero's header via deflection seals it as holders survive a scare
RESULT: Egypt 1-1 Australia (4-2 pens) — Salah's Panenka helps Egypt reach the World Cup last 16 for the first time
RESULT: Colombia 1-0 Ghana — Jhon Arias' 14th-minute strike sends Colombia through to face Switzerland
NEXT: Sun — Brazil vs Norway (4:00 PM ET, NY/NJ) & Mexico vs England (8:00 PM ET, Mexico City)
NEXT: Mon — Portugal vs Spain (3:00 PM ET, Dallas) & USA vs Belgium (8:00 PM ET, Seattle)
NEXT: Tue — Argentina vs Egypt (12:00 PM ET, Atlanta) & Switzerland vs Colombia (4:00 PM ET, Vancouver)
